newsitem.title: USA: Versa Technologies plans plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: Versa Technologies plans plant expansion.

text.p: Versa Technologies Inc said Wednesday it plans to add 40,000 square feet to its Eder Industries Inc plant in Oak Creek, Wis.

The addition will include manufacturing and office space. Construction on the $2.5 million project, which includes additional automated equipment, is to begin in April with completion targeted for October 1, 1997.
Eder designs and manufactures custom electronic and electrical systems for original equipment manufacturers. Versa acquired Eder in October 1996.
